parsed_response.concise_technical_rationale: Design intent of Node 1: V-001, a three-phase FWKO, separates produced fluids by density at nominal 60 psig/130 °F into gas (PV-101 to fuel gas, excess to burn pit), oil (to Heater–Treater, then V-003 Electrostatic Desalter) and free water (to water treatment). All six source elements were examined with the applicable SYS-08 guidewords across the full boundary: inlet; gas, oil and water outlets; E-001; relief path; and the fuel-gas and burn-pit interfaces. Highest priority goes to deviations that can cause loss of containment or downstream overpressure. First is high pressure from PV-101 failure or blocked outlets; this relies on PSV-101 A/B, whose sizing and set pressure relative to the ambiguous 60/125 psig data are unverified. Next are low oil level causing gas blow-by into the Heater–Treater, fire/explosion, and high level causing liquid carryover to fuel gas and the burn pit. The only source-supported human/procedural item, start-up without bypass opening, ranks high: line-up omissions in infrequent manual tasks are credible, and no procedural or engineered barrier is described. Most safeguards appear only as tags, so their function, independence and alarm/trip capability need verification. Risk rankings are for prioritisation only, and no organizational facts are asserted.
explicitly_non_applicable_or_unresolved: Organizational factors (staffing, competence systems, management of change, safety culture): no packet evidence; not assessed, and no organizational finding asserted (SYS-09).

Stop/shutdown procedural deviations (sequencing, trapped pressure, incomplete depressurisation or isolation before maintenance) and other start-up hazards (e.g., air purging, pressurisation rate): the Start/Stop element is listed (SYS-07) but no source-specific scenario is given; unresolved and addressed only by recommendation in N1-F15.
Vacuum/negative pressure in V-001: no credible mechanism can be identified from packet data at nominal 60 psig; unresolved rather than analysed.
Reverse flow (N1-F05) and E-001 (N1-F13) scenarios: credibility is provisional pending relative pressures, non-return device information and E-001 service data.
Reverse and Another guidewords for Temperature, and Reverse for Level: not physically meaningful beyond scenarios already captured; non-applicable.
Toxic (e.g., H2S) and hydrate hazards: gas and water composition not supplied; unresolved.
Internal deviations of the Heater–Treater, V-003 Electrostatic Desalter, water treatment, fuel-gas system and burn pit: outside the Node 1 boundary; only interface consequences addressed.
Meaning of the published '125 psig to 200 °F' operating-condition text versus 60 psig/130 °F nominal (design versus maximum operating envelope): unresolved.
